heroHeadline: ARTEMIS II CREW WITNESSES 5 METEOR IMPACTS ON LUNAR SURFACE — FIRST DIRECT HUMAN OBSERVATION
heroSubtitle: Oct 11: Crew observed 5 meteor impact flashes on the lunar surface and described unexpected yellow and green color hues — new perceptual data from the first crewed lunar flyby in 50+ years. Oct 8: Splashdown footage released from inside the Orion capsule.
footerNote: Data sourced from NASA.gov, OIG Reports, SpaceNews, Ars Technica, Congressional appropriations. Tier 1: NASA/ESA/Official. Tier 2: SpaceNews/Ars Technica/Reuters. Tier 3: Planetary Society/AIAA.
